label: Incorrect/unclear transmission of information
definition: The operator transmits to other actors information that is incorrect or unclear, e.g., use of wrong callsign.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.1, Table A1, p. 17

label: No transmission of information
definition: The operator does not transmit information that is necessary for other actors to operate safely/effectively.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.1, Table A1, p. 17

label: Incorrect decision or plan
definition: The operator elaborates an action plan or makes a decision which is insufficient to manage the situation.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.1, Table A1, p. 15

label: Late decision or plan
definition: The operator does not elaborate on a timely action plan or decision to manage the situation.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.1, Table A1, p. 15

label: No decision or plan
definition: The operator does not elaborate on any action plan or decision to manage the situation.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.1, Table A1, p. 16

label: Workaround in normal conditions
definition: The operator decides to intentionally deviate from an agreed procedure or practice in a normal operating condition.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.1, Table A1, p. 16

label: Workaround in exceptional conditions
definition: The operator decides to intentionally deviate from an agreed procedure or practice in an exceptional operating condition.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.1, Table A1, p. 16

label: No/wrong/late visual detection
definition: The operator does not detect, or detects too late or inaccurately, a visual signal necessary to formulate a proper action plan or make a correct decision.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.1, Table A1, p. 15

label: Inadequate risk assessment
definition: Operations leader does not adequately evaluate the risks associated with a specific operation or scenario.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.3, Table A3, p. 24

label: Inadequate crew or team makeup or composition
definition: Operations leader allows inadequate makeup or composition of crew or team for a given activity/operation.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.3, Table A3, p. 24

label: Directed task with inadequate equipment
definition: Operations leader directs operators to undertake an activity that is beyond the capabilities of their equipment.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.3, Table A3, p. 24

label: No personnel measures against regular risky behaviour
definition: An operations leader does not identify an operator who regularly exhibits risky behaviours or does not institute the necessary remedial actions.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.3, Table A3, p. 23

label: Inappropriate behaviour affects learning
definition: Inappropriate behaviour of operations leader affects learning by operators, which manifests itself in actions that are either inappropriate to their skill level or violate standard procedures.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.3, Table A3, p. 23

label: Inadequate leadership or supervision
definition: Availability, competency, quality or timeliness of leadership or supervision does not meet task demands.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.3, Table A3, p. 24

label: No correction of unsafe practices
definition: An operations leader does not correct known unsafe practices, conditions, guidance or procedure, which allows hazardous practices within the scope of his / her authority.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.3, Table A3, p. 24

label: No enforcement of existing rules
definition: Operations leader does not enforce organizational and operating rules.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.3, Table A3, p. 24

label: Directed deviation
definition: Operations leader directs a subordinate to deviate from existing regulations, procedures or technical guidance.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.3, Table A3, p. 25

label: Safety culture
definition: There is a poor safety culture or a low company morale in the organisation, leading to a poor attitude to safety in the organisation.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.4, Table A4, p. 25

label: Economic pressure
definition: Economic conditions and pressures to keep schedule and costs put a pressure on the organisation resulting in a negative impact on safety.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.4, Table A4, p. 26

label: Equipment/parts/materials availability
definition: Equipment, materials, or parts that operators have to use is not available to them at the time that the task has to be performed.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.4, Table A4, p. 26

label: Design of equipment or procedures
definition: The design of the equipment / procedure to support the operation / task is not suitable to allow the task to be performed safely. The equipment might also prevent operators working in an efficient manner and indirectly encourage short-cuts or workarounds.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.4, Table A4, p. 26

label: Safety risk management (proactive)
definition: Identification of safety hazards and risk assessments and mitigation are not carried out, or are carried out but do not identify and make available relevant safety issues.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.4, Table A4, p. 25

label: Inattention
definition: Operator is not alert/ready to process immediately available information.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.2, Table A2, p. 20

label: Inadequate experience
definition: Operator does not have sufficient experience with a task at hand.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.2, Table A2, p. 23

label: Lack of proficiency
definition: Operator capability to accomplish a task does not meet the performance levels expected from her/his skill level.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.2, Table A2, p. 23

label: Inadequate training or currency
definition: Operator does not meet general training or recurring training requirements for the task assigned to her/him.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.2, Table A2, p. 23

label: Ergonomics and human machine interface issues
definition: The ergonomics of tools and human machines interface, including controls, switches, displays, warning systems and symbology degrade the operator’s performance.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.2, Table A2, p. 18

label: Technology creates an unsafe situation
definition: The design, malfunction, failure, symbology, logic or other aspects of technical/automated systems degrade the operator’s performance.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.2, Table A2, p. 18

label: Workspace or working position incompatible with operation
definition: The interior or exterior workspace layout or the working position are incompatible with the task requirements of the operator.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.2, Table A2, p. 18

label: Communication equipment inadequate
definition: Communication equipment is inadequate or unavailable to support task demands. Communications can be voice, data or multi-sensory.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.2, Table A2, p. 18

label: Fatigue
definition: Diminished mental capability due to fatigue, restricted or shortened sleep, mental activity during prolonged wakefulness or disturbance of circadian rhythm degrades operator performance.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.2, Table A2, p. 22

label: Operation more difficult due to weather and environment
definition: Weather conditions and/or environment make controlling the operation more difficult.
source: Stroeve et al. (2023) Safety 9(1):14, Appendix A.2, Table A2, p. 17
